A sad melody.
The tears just welled up on their own...
She kept on singing.
I couldn't stop crying.
And I was sleepy.
So sleepy.
So sleepy...
.........Hot☆{p}
rows.06:47b4:
Lulled by my song.
Don't worry.
Your body isn't really burning.
That agony is only happening in a dream.
But from now on, you will go on feeling that pain forever.
I'll put a curse on you, so that you never wake up.
Tell me, where would you like to sleep?
Shall I lay you down somewhere no one will ever find you?
Then you'd starve to death in a few days, and you'd escape the agony of the flames.
Ahaha.........
Ahahahaahahahaahaa........."
Her words echoed eerily inside my head.
Inside my dream of flames, I could do nothing but pray to be freed from this agony as soon as possible...{p}
rows.06:4b4c:
...I'm not lying.
Somebody actually tried it.
A student at our school.
He was good-looking, and he'd never had trouble with girls to begin with.
But there was one woman he just couldn't win over, no matter what.
...What kind of woman do you think?
Heh, a teacher.
A new one, and real sexy.
He used the cursed book to win her over.{p}
rows.06:4c90:
He held the book in his left hand and pictured the flame of love.
And then...
What do you know, all kinds of images started popping into his head.
Well, not images exactly...
More like inspiration.
Words of love came to him one after another, exactly the kind women love to hear.
A flood of words.
So he called the teacher over after school and seduced her with sweet talk.{p}
rows.06:5738:
This book plants suggestions in people's heads and makes them see illusions.
Maybe there's a devil living inside it, huh?
They say that in exchange for showing people sweet dreams, it cuts a few years off the life of whoever dreams them.
That's a curse, alright.{p}
rows.06:6128:
"{a}, you're way too cocky."
Shindo was glaring at me menacingly.
"This book's got a seriously nasty curse on it.
Get this: whoever gets hit with this book gets cursed.
First, you put your hand on the book and picture the name of the person you want to curse.
Then you smack them on the head with the book.
And that's how the curse takes hold.
If you'd just put your hand on it like you were told, I would've let you curse somebody else.{p}
rows.06:63d4:
You've got a rotten personality, you know that?
Did you really think I'd quit just because you said that?
You've gotta be kidding.
There's no backing out for you now.
If you quit here, you're gonna get cursed for sure.
Well, you'll see.
I'm about to ask you the questions.
Answer them seriously.
If you just answer any old way, you're the one who'll be in trouble.
Whether you get cursed or not depends on your answers.{p}
rows.06:7478:

You've betrayed people, haven't you?
Then somebody's bound to hate you.
How can you not realize that?
People hate you, no doubt about it.
They hate you.
And they hold grudges against you.{p}
